title: Schema B for NAP configuration
description: Input file description for the NAP configuration application. Setting the config: HSDN-Config, VL-Map, local VL-Mappinng, TDMA

naps.description: List of all NAPs within the network

cycle_time.description: Cycle time of the complete schedule in time units

timesync_priority.description: Time synchronisation priority of the NAP

vl_mapping_inner_to_outer.description: List of the vl_mappings from the inner domain to the interfaces of the outer domain (for this NAP)

vl_mapping_outer_to_inner.description: List of all vl_mappings from the interface of the outer domain to the inner domain (for this NAP)

tdma_slots.description: List of all tdma_slots of the NAP

vl_mapping_inner_to_outer.description: VL mapping from inner to outer domain of the NAP

inner_domain_link_id.description: Inner domain links to which the redundant VLs belong. Ordered like vl_id. Only one entry means no redundancy

vl_id.description: VL IDs of the redundant virtual links. Only one entry means no redundancy

if_ch_number.description: Interface Channel Number to which the VL Mapping belongs

if_number.description: Interface Number to which the VL Mapping belongs

if_type.description: Interface type to which the VL Mapping belongs

last.description: Booleans showing for each VL if this was the last hop of this VL, the packets for this VL will not be forwarded to the other HSDN link / next hop. Ordered like vl_id

deduplication_method.description: Type of deduplication used for redundant VLs

deduplication_source.description: Source of the deduplication if VL is redundant

vl_mapping_outer_to_inner.description: VL mapping from outer to inner domain of the NAP

inner_domain_link_id.description: Inner domain link to which the VL Mapping belongs

vl_id.description: VL to which the VL Mapping belongs

if_ch_number.description: Interface Channel Number to which the VL Mapping belongs

if_number.description: Interface Number to which the VL Mapping belongs

if_type.description: Interface type to which the VL Mapping belongs

tdma_slot.description: A slot in the TDMA schedule

inner_domain_link_id.description: Inner domain link to which the slot belongs

start.description: Start time of the slot in time units

end.description: End time of the slot in time units

is_deterministic.description: True if VL is deterministic, best-effort else

local_destination.description: True if packets must be transmitted only via outer domain interfaces (i.e., local destination)

virtual_links.description: List of virtual link ID(s) assigned to this slot
